flawed_step: Line 0009 incorrectly claims that the x-axis is transformed into the line x+y=0.
counterexample: The point (1,0) lies on the x-axis, but L(1,0)=(1,1), which does not satisfy x+y=0 since 1+1=2. In fact, L(Ox) is the line y=x.
assessment_summary: The proof relies on an incorrect description of the transformed x-axis. Although the intended angle conclusion happens to remain true for the actual image line y=x, the stated proof contains a concretely false step.
